'''Dunesa Rul''' was an individual who came from a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Rul grew up helping his family by apprenticing with a local [[Metalsmith/Legends|metalsmith]]. Wanting to test his skills, Rul traveled to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and worked in several forges until the quality of his [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] caught the attention of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clans. With their support, he opened his own forge at a young age.<ref name="The Final Blade" />

Rul's creations, prized within the Mandalorians, were often handed down through generations. Rul was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in an explosion during an [[Altercation between Clan Mettir and Clan Ironstone|altercation]] between [[Clan Mettir]] and [[Clan Ironstone]], who were both trying to claim one of his finest pieces&mdash;a [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] [[Dagger/Legends|dagger]] which became known as [[The Final Blade of Dunesa Rul]]. Both clans were wiped out and the dagger was never found.<ref name="The Final Blade" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dunesa Rul was first mentioned in the codex entry "Mandalorian Relics: The Final Blade of Dunesa Rul," introduced in Game Update 7.2: ''Showdown on Ruhnuk'', released on [[December 13]], [[2022]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Showdown on Ruhnuk">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20221213-0|text=Game Update 7.2 "Showdown on Ruhnuk" is live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
